_comment: MN cities cross-FY source-gap residual (MNCITY-02, CONTEXT D-03). A residual city is one enumerated in a FY roster but with NO Governmental Funds financial total (filed nothing) — it is NOT created as a municipality (no phantom rows). Across FY2012-2023, ZERO such cities were found: every enumerated city had a finite Total Revenues/Expenditures. The per-FY roster size varies (846-853) because not every MN city files every year (normal incorporation/dissolution + filing timing), not because of dropped data. Generated 2026-06-27.
source: Minnesota Office of the State Auditor City/County Finances Report
